posts.text:
I’m so excited to shine a spotlight on St. Louis with @hasanthehun this Friday!

This May Day, we're teaming up for a day of action to stand up to Trump, fight back against ICE, and demand more for everyday people.

Tune in on Twitch on Friday afternoon to join us!

Video

I’m so thankful for our amazing STL-DSA canvassers!

Together, we’re building our movement by talking with our neighbors about fighting Trump, lowering costs, and getting ICE out of our communities for good.

I’m so glad to have them by my side as I campaign to go back to Congress and keep delivering for STL.

I had a great time at the St. Louis Earth Day Festival!

Always a pleasure to connect with St. Louis’ small business community, local activists doing essential work to protect our environment, and anyone else who enjoyed two beautiful days in Forest Park.

St. Louisans know how lucky we are to live in a special place with so much natural beauty. I can’t wait to go back to Congress to keep fighting to ensure that beauty is protected for generations to come.

Video

SEVERE WEATHER WARNING:

To all those in the St. Louis area, exercise caution today as we expect flooding, large hail, and strong tornadoes this afternoon and evening.

Make a plan to take shelter in a basement or the lowest floor of a sturdy building far from windows, doors, or outside walls.

Ensure that you have a flashlight, first aid kit, non-perishable food, and other necessities ready.

Please keep yourself and your loved ones safe and continue to follow the news to stay aware of the evol

I’m so proud to be endorsed by Beyond the Ballot!

Young people have always been at the forefront of our movement to guarantee reproductive freedom, protect our environment, and build an economy that works for all of us.

I’m so excited to have their support as we fight to ensure that the people of St. Louis get the healthcare, housing, and education that our communities deserve.

I had a great time at Ted Drewes celebrating their 97th anniversary!

People from near and far, young and well-seasoned, came to enjoy a classic St. Louis stop along the historic Route 66 Highway.

Congrats on nearly a century of being a staple of our community!

I’ll always stand with people over profit.

The health of St. Louis residents must be the first consideration when outside developers look to build data centers in our neighborhoods.

St. Louis has already suffered for decades from projects that have been forced on our communities in the past. This time, our leaders must listen to the people and keep our families from being exposed to uncertain risks.

Video

I’m so proud to once again earn the endorsement of UNITE HERE Local 74.

Together, we’ll keep fighting to protect and strengthen workers' rights to organize and ensure that the people of St. Louis have the workplace protections and true livable wages they deserve.

Senate Republicans voting to spend billions on funding ICE’s reign of terror, while critical programs that serve millions are stripped of funding, shows exactly where their true priorities lie.

This is just the latest example of Trump’s fascist, authoritarian agenda in action. The MAGA movement wants our tax dollars spent on federal agents committing acts of violence in our neighborhoods, not funding the programs that our communities need.

The House must vote no on funding ICE.

#AbolishICE

I had a blast at the Liberty Ball!

I want to extend a big thank you to @queers_4_change and @rehabbarstl for inviting me to join you as a guest judge. I’m always proud to stand with St. Louis’ LGBTQ+ community, especially now, at a time when gay and trans rights are under attack across Missouri and the entire country.

I’ll keep fighting for the rights of every St. Louisan and make sure that our fundamental freedoms are protected from MAGA Republicans and their fascist agenda.

Video

The St. Louis Board of Public Service’s decision to approve the construction of a data center near the Armory at a time when the cost of water, electricity, and other utilities are already on the rise for residents across St. Louis is completely unacceptable.

Community input must be paramount when private developers and the AI industry come to St. Louis seeking to extract profit, not serve the people. Any decisions that impact our neighborhoods must respect the voices of St. Louis residents ove

Join us this week for our volunteer events, both virtually and around St. Louis!

We’re canvassing across STL to have conversations with our neighbors about sending a true fighter for St. Louis back to Congress.

Not in the district? Join us for a phone bank!

Can we count on you to help build our movement?

FRIDAY, MAY 1ST:

Tune in as @hasanthehun comes to St. Louis to join Cori Bush in honor of May Day!

Cori and Hasan will team up in STL to demand livable wages, abolishing ICE, and guaranteeing the education, housing, and healthcare that our communities deserve.

More details to come soon!

I am heartbroken by the shooting that took place last night in Ferguson. I pray for the family of Ronald Milton, for the other two victims who were injured and hospitalized, as well as for the patrons traumatized as a result of this tragedy.

As we mourn this loss, my thoughts are with all those who have been affected by the gun violence that our families in the St. Louis area are currently facing. The systemic violence that we are suffering from is a public health crisis that must be addressed
For folks interested in joining the Office and Event Planning team: mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…
For folks interested in joining the Digital/Communications team: mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…

👇 Join Team Cori 👇

We’re actively recruiting volunteers for our Digital/Communications Team, our Event Planning Team, and our Campaign Office Team.

👉 Fill out the form that matches your skills, and we’ll be in touch soon with an invitation to join us!
